items.resolves_issue: LCDPwn CVE 计数错报（57 实为 55）与 CDP 端措辞偏差（『约 20』应为原文 20+）；同时阻断旧证据 qc-r1-lcdpwn-scope 的 claim 错误源头。
items.claim: LCDPwn 项目页自报研究规模并逐一列出 55 个 CVE ID（区间 CVE-2020-3505 至 CVE-2023-20047，引入语为 "The following are CVE IDs assigned at the moment."）；CDP 端原措辞为 "found another 20 bugs in 5 types of Cisco devices"，Q&A 改述为 "found another 20+ bug on Cisco devices"；设备/厂商端为 "nearly 70 kinds of network devices from 30 well-known vendors are vulnerable"；LLDP 端为 "nearly 50 bugs are found in a wide variety of devices"。全部规模数值为作者自报，无独立第三方核验；项目页以 "most of bugs are valid and have been fixed" 隐含厂商确认，但未给出逐厂商 advisory。项目页 Q&A 标注研究由 cq674350529 完成。本证据用以更正旧证据 qc-r1-lcdpwn-scope 中『逐一列出 57 个 CVE ID』的计数错误（实际 55）。
